description_en: Reports SMS conversion rate statistics to the Alibaba Cloud SMS platform
description_zh: 将短信转化率统计数据反馈给阿里云短信平台
name: ConversionDataIntl

parameters.help_en:
The point in time for conversion rate observation. The value must be a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds (long integer).

If this field is not specified, the current timestamp is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
转化率观测的时间点。必须是Unix时间戳，毫秒级别长整型。

如果不指定该字段：默认当前的时间戳
parameters.name: report_time

parameters.help_en:
The conversion rate monitoring report value.
This parameter is of the double type. Valid values: [0,1]
parameters.help_zh:
转化率监控回报值。
该参数取值为double类型 ，区间是[0,1]
parameters.name: conversion_rate

Code.description_en:

Code.description_zh:
